categories.label: Suspicion cards held (tiebreaker)

notes: 7 rounds. Bonuses for Develops/Commissions/Fortifies/Garrisons/Absolves depend on values printed on the player board (not in rulebook text), so they are number inputs; enter 0 below the threshold. Traitor Outsider reduces each unpaid Debt loss by 1: enter unpaid count and subtract manually or lower the count. Thief Outsider scores 1 VP per Suspicion you hold (include in Converts). Solo AI scoring has special rules (min 1 VP per Convert) not modelled. If still tied after both tiebreakers, victory is shared.
